message.content: Wolfgang invites Li Hua to a concert that is scheduled for March 7th at 6 PM. This information can be found in the conversation where Wolfgang mentions, "That sounds amazing! I'm totally in! Can't wait! 🎶" followed by, "It'll be a great time. I could use a break from all the coding. Got any favorite bands performing?"
